title: 第119章 这次不是一个人
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋广福的手机还在亮。

屏幕上两个字一闪一闪。

老人盯着那两个字，手指僵在被子边，嘴唇动了两下。

“我老伴。”

赵护士的手停在手机上，等孙志强一句话。

孙志强没让人直接挂断。

“开免提，护士接。别让他自己讲。”

赵护士把手机拿起来，点了接通。

电话那头立刻传出一个老太太的声音，急得发抖。

“老宋？你怎么不说话？你是不是又不舒服了？”

宋广福下意识想抬头。

林野按住床栏。

“您先听护士说。”

赵护士把手机拿远一点，声音比平时软了半分。

“阿姨，我是急诊护士。老宋人在医生边上，正复查呢。您先听我说，别急着往医院跑。”

电话那头停了一下，像是人坐不住了。

“复查？他不是说明天就能回家吗？我腿不好，他要是住院，我这边门都不好出。”

宋广福闭了闭眼。

“你别来。”

声音很轻，刚出口就被心电监护的短音盖过去。

赵护士直接接住话。

“阿姨，您先别动身。夜里路不好走，您腿又不方便。先帮我们对两样东西。”

“你说，你说。”

林野已经把记录纸往自己这边拉了一点。

赵护士用指节敲了敲记录纸，等林野报问题。

林野压低声音。

“先问几点开始闷。再问今晚含过那瓶小药没有，阿司匹林是不是长期吃，平时药也带一句。”

说完这句，他才发现自己把纸边攥皱了。

他没再看白班那句“未见明显急性改变”。

赵护士照着问。

电话那头老太太说得乱。

“他傍晚就说胸口堵，吃饭也没吃几口。我让他去医院，他还嫌麻烦。药啊，药在电视柜第二个抽屉，他血压药每天吃，有时候忘。那个小白瓶，他说胸闷时含一片，前阵子社区医生开的。”

孙志强听到“小白瓶”，抬眼。

“让她看瓶子名。”

赵护士立刻接上：“阿姨，您能不能把那个小白瓶拿出来，看一眼上面写什么？”

电话那头传来拖鞋蹭地的声音，还有柜门被拉开的响动。

老太太一边找，一边喘。

“我眼神不好，你等等，我找老花镜。”

宋广福急了。

“她腿不好，别让她翻。”

“她不翻，我们这边更不知道你平时含什么。”

赵护士一句话把他按回去。

林野看着监护屏。

心率八十六。

血压还停在九十多。

不算崩，但也不让人放心。

红区门口传来脚步声。

心内科值班医生到了。

来的是三十多岁的男医生，头发还没完全压下去，口罩挂在一边。他进门没寒暄，先拿心电图。

“哪张新图？”

孙志强把三张纸推过去。

“最上面这张。门口找回来后做的。白班两张在下面。”

心内科医生把纸条并在一起，眼睛很快扫过胸前导联，又看了老人一眼。

“胸闷现在几分？”

宋广福没反应过来。

Page (1/3)

Song Guangfu's cell phone was still on.

Two words flashed on the screen.

The old man stared at those two words, his fingers froze on the edge of the quilt, and his lips moved twice.

"My wife."

Nurse Zhao's hand stopped on the phone, waiting for Sun Zhiqiang to say a word.

Sun Zhiqiang did not let anyone hang up directly.

"On speakerphone, the nurse will take the call. Don't let him speak on his own."

Nurse Zhao picked up the phone and clicked to connect.

An old lady's voice immediately came from the other end of the phone, trembling with anxiety.

"Old Song? Why don't you speak? Are you feeling uncomfortable again?"

Song Guangfu subconsciously wanted to raise his head.

Lin Ye pressed the bed rail.

"Listen to the nurse first."

Nurse Zhao held the phone further away and her voice was half softer than usual.

"Auntie, I am an emergency nurse. Lao Song is next to the doctor and is undergoing a review. Please listen to me first and don't rush to the hospital."

The person on the other end of the phone paused for a moment, as if he couldn't sit still.

"Recheck? Didn't he say he can go home tomorrow? My legs are not good. If he is hospitalized, I won't be able to go out."

Song Guangfu closed his eyes.

"Don't come."

The voice was very soft, and as soon as it came out, it was covered by the short tone of the ECG monitor.

Nurse Zhao answered the question directly.

"Auntie, don't leave yet. It's difficult to walk at night, and your legs are inconvenient. Help us get rid of two things first."

"Say, you say."

Lin Ye had already pulled the recording paper a little closer to him.

Nurse Zhao tapped the recording paper with her knuckles and waited for Lin Ye to report the problem.

Lin Ye lowered his voice.

"First, I asked what time I started feeling bored. Then I asked if I had taken the small bottle of medicine in my mouth tonight, and if I had been taking aspirin for a long time. I also asked about the usual medicine."

After saying this, he realized that he had wrinkled the edge of the paper.

He didn't look at the day shift's statement that "no obvious acute changes were seen."

Nurse Zhao asked accordingly.

The old lady on the other end of the phone was talking nonsense.

"He complained of chest congestion in the evening and didn't even take a few mouthfuls of food. I asked him to go to the hospital, but he still found it troublesome. The medicine is in the second drawer of the TV cabinet. He takes blood pressure medicine every day, but sometimes forgets about it. He said that he takes one piece of the small white bottle when he has chest tightness. It was prescribed by a community doctor a while ago."

Sun Zhiqiang raised his eyes when he heard "little white bottle".

"Show her the bottle name."

Nurse Zhao immediately answered: "Auntie, can you take out that little white bottle and take a look at what's written on it?"

There was the sound of slippers scraping against the floor and the sound of cabinet doors being opened on the other end of the phone.

The old lady panted while searching.

"My eyesight is bad. Wait a minute while I look for reading glasses."

Song Guangfu was anxious.

"She has bad legs, don't let her turn over."

"If she doesn't turn it over, we don't know what you usually have in your mouth."

Nurse Zhao pushed him back with one word.

Lin Ye looked at the monitoring screen.

Heart rate eighty-six.

My blood pressure is still over ninety.

It's not a crash, but it's not reassuring either.

There were footsteps at the door of the red zone.

The cardiology doctor on duty arrived.

The person who came was a male doctor in his thirties, his hair had not been completely suppressed, and his mask was hanging on one side.He entered without greetings and took an electrocardiogram first.

"Which new picture?"

Sun Zhiqiang pushed three pieces of paper over.

"The top one. Made after I found it at the door. The two from the day shift are at the bottom."

The cardiologist put the notes together, quickly scanned the leads on his chest, and looked at the old man again.

"How bad is the chest tightness now?"

Song Guangfu didn't react.
